The '''Harrin sector'''<ref name="EAOC" /> was located in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA Harrin" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the [[Harrin system/Legends|Harrin system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of which was also named [[Harrin/Legends|Harrin]].<ref name="CSWE Harrin">{{CSWECite|II|22|Harrin}}</ref> The Harrin [[Star system/Legends|system]] lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], and it was also situated at the endpoint of the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]].<ref name="TEA Harrin" />

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Harrin system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA Harrin" /> The system became a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[17,000 BBY]] and [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]. By the latter [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the planet fell within the territory known as the [[Corellian Hegemony]], which was economically dominated by the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Harrin system fell within the borders of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA Harrin" /> By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the system was situated in the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Harrin [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was introduced in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']].<ref name="Kira">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Harrin system in grid square L-15.<ref name="TEA Harrin" />
